criteria.requirement: Add csvkit.utilities.csvfind.find_columns and actual CSVFind utility/module entry using CSVKitUtility and native FilteringCSVReader predicates. Accept exact --value (including empty) or explicit --regex, selected columns and nonnegative bounded --sample-size; scan logical records once and report every selected column by zero-based index/name/count plus bounded 1-based logical data-row samples. Duplicate column names remain distinct. JSON schema=1 reports rows and columns; CSV output respects --zero only for displayed column indexes. Preserve cells, handle short rows as native empty missing fields, empty inputs, no matches and generator errors; never rescan per column or silently drop matches beyond sample budget.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
